settings.resetDescription: Resets ALL insight data for this workspace (findings + scan history + workspace-opt action document). Lenses and settings are preserved. Use this to clear the board if similar findings have accumulated across scans.
settings.clearLedger: Clear the ledger too — old sessions will be rescanned from scratch (fixed issues may return)
settings.deepResetConfirm: ALL insight data and the ledger will be deleted. The next scan will process every session from scratch, so even fixed issues may return from old sessions. Are you sure?
settings.resetConfirm: All findings, scan history, and the workspace-opt action document will be deleted. The ledger is preserved, so old sessions will not be rescanned. Are you sure?

lessons.title: Self-healing (loop protection and lesson extraction)
lessons.descriptionMiddle: ): the tool loop tracks repeated failures within a turn (warn after 2 identical call failures and 3 consecutive failures from the same tool); when the circuit breaker is enabled, it blocks the fifth repeat and stops the turn after 8 consecutive failures. Sessions with consecutive bad turns receive the
lessons.descriptionAfter: label and autonomous turns are suspended (manual chat is never affected). Lesson extraction distills short lessons from failed turns and injects them into later turns.
lessons.guardWarningsHint: Adds an actionable recovery hint to repeated failed tool calls (diagnose, try different arguments or a different tool). It never blocks execution.
lessons.hardStopHint: Above the threshold, an identical failed call is blocked before execution and repeated failures from the same tool end the turn at the halt threshold (guardrail_halt). Disabled by default.
lessons.exactWarnHint: Warn after this many identical failed calls (tool + arguments). 0 uses the default of 2.
lessons.exactBlockHint: When the circuit breaker is enabled, block an identical failed call before execution at this count. 0 uses the default of 5.
lessons.sameToolWarnHint: Warn after this many consecutive failures from the same tool, even with different arguments. 0 uses the default of 3.
lessons.sameToolHaltHint: When the circuit breaker is enabled, end the turn after this many consecutive failures from the same tool. 0 uses the default of 8.
lessons.noProgressWarnHint: Warn when successful repetitions of the same read-only call exceed this count. 0 uses the default of 2.
lessons.noProgressBlockHint: When the circuit breaker is enabled, block the same read-only call at this repetition count. 0 uses the default of 5.
lessons.stuckThresholdHint: A session with this many consecutive bad turns (turn error / guardrail halt) receives the 'stuck' label and autonomous turns are rejected. A clean turn resets the counter; removing the label does too. 0 disables it.
lessons.reflectHint: Distills a short lesson in the background from a bad turn and writes it to workspace-wide lessons.jsonl. The five newest lessons are injected into each turn's dynamic context. A repeated failure pattern updates its existing lesson instead of accumulating copies.
lessons.maxAgeHint: A lesson is considered stale and pruned if its failure pattern does not recur within this many days. Lower values forget faster. 0 uses the built-in default of 2 days.
